verdict.rationale: Steel documents an official Steel CLI that runs full browser workflows from the terminal: start a session, navigate, click, fill, type, extract, and stop. The docs also pair it with an installable steel-browser skill so agents can drive the browser, and show commands like `steel forge agentkit`; the probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and a detailed command reference or install and auth details in the evidence.
